title: 同態加密運算服務
summary: 以密文代數、噪聲預算與精度管理串連 16 個原創技術單元、32 步；涵蓋原理解析、架構圖、假想量化、合成資料實驗、競爭失效原因及可重算驗收。
summaryEn: Sixteen original technical units and 32 tasks connect ciphertext algebra, noise budgets and precision with principles, architectures, assumed calculations, synthetic experiments, competing failure causes and reproducible acceptance.
scope: 公開原理的本地科教模擬與工程判讀。只使用自製、合成或明確授權的資料；不操作真實受害主機、他人帳號、工業控制或超算設施。數值不代表廠商規格或實測效能，完成課程不是專業資格、真實裝置操作經歷或生產部署認證。
scopeEn: Local educational simulation and engineering interpretation of public principles. Use self-made, synthetic or explicitly licensed data only; do not operate real victim hosts, other accounts, industrial control or supercomputing facilities. Values are not product specifications or measured performance. Completion is not a qualification, real-equipment experience or production-deployment certification.

stages.title: 表示與安全
stages.description: 四個技術單元依序完成「表示與安全」的架構與證據，共八步可分別儲存的本地科教實作。
stages.descriptionEn: Four technical units develop representation and security through eight separately saved local educational tasks.

steps.title: 明密文邊界：原理與架構
steps.objective: 以「明密文邊界」建立原理、介面與可反駁模型。
steps.objectiveEn: Build principles, interfaces and a falsifiable model for plain/cipher boundaries.
steps.instruction: 先觀察師傅的「明密文邊界」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：同態運算保護處理中資料但允許解密結果可見。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「畫資料持有者、運算者及結果接收者。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。
steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor demonstration for plain/cipher boundaries. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Homomorphic computation protects processing while allowing result decryption. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Draw data owner, evaluator and result recipient. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.
steps.observation: 畫資料持有者、運算者及結果接收者。 核對上述原理的適用範圍並記錄不符合預期之處。
steps.observationEn: Draw data owner, evaluator and result recipient. Check the scope of the stated principle and record departures from expectations.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：同態加密使所有輸出永不可讀。 應檢查資料版本、單位、信任邊界與可區分原因的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Homomorphic encryption makes all outputs unreadable forever. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 提交「明密文邊界」兩情境架構圖、假設與可反駁預測，並說明「畫資料持有者、運算者及結果接收者。」如何辨別它們。
steps.checkEn: Submit a two-case architecture, assumptions and falsifiable prediction for plain/cipher boundaries; explain how the proposed evidence discriminates the cases.

knowledge.title: 原理與架構依據
knowledge.text: 同態運算保護處理中資料但允許解密結果可見。
knowledge.textEn: Homomorphic computation protects processing while allowing result decryption.

knowledge.title: 辨別模型的證據
knowledge.text: 畫資料持有者、運算者及結果接收者。 保留基準、輸入版本、單位與誤差範圍；這項證據只支援已列出的模型邊界，不能自動推廣為整套真實系統保證。
knowledge.textEn: Draw data owner, evaluator and result recipient. Preserve baselines, input versions, units and errors; this evidence supports stated model boundaries, not an automatic guarantee for an entire real system.

knowledge.title: 本課量化算例
knowledge.text: 玩具模環 Z₁₇ 的明文 8+12≡3 (mod17)，8×12≡11。若欲表達一般整數 20，模數 17 會迴繞；這只是明文算術，不是安全加密參數或密文安全實作。
knowledge.textEn: In toy plaintext ring Z17, 8+12≡3 and 8×12≡11 modulo 17. Representing ordinary integer 20 would wrap. This illustrates plaintext arithmetic only, not secure encryption parameters or a secure ciphertext implementation.

knowledge.title: 任務延伸｜遊戲交班延伸：先界定介面
knowledge.titleEn: Mission extension | Campaign transfer: define interfaces first
knowledge.text:
本課「同態加密運算服務」的「明密文邊界：原理與架構」是這項延伸任務的檢核點。 畫出輸入資料、處理狀態、傳輸與輸出的邊界，在每條箭頭旁寫量、單位、正方向與資料版本。再打開「可信服務：中斷後的交班」，比較哪一個介面可類比、哪一個不可類比；不可因為畫面相似就共用數值參數。

需留下的證據：提交一張介面圖與輸入版本、時間追蹤、資源計數與可重播的小型測試的欄位樣本；將假設值、來源值與本次實測值分欄。

驗證與交接：每個介面至少有一個可核對量；提出一項能讓模型失效的邊界改變，而不是只重述公式。
knowledge.textEn:
The checkpoint is “Plain/cipher boundaries: principles and architecture” in “Homomorphic-encryption computing services”. Draw the input, processing state, transport and output boundaries; label quantities, units, sign conventions and data revisions on each arrow. Open “Trusted Service: Handoff After an Outage” and identify which interfaces transfer and which do not. Similar-looking scenes do not justify shared numerical parameters.

Evidence to retain: Submit an interface diagram and sample fields for input version, time traces, resource counters and a replayable small test, separating assumed, sourced and newly measured values.

Verification and handover: Each interface has a checkable quantity. Identify one boundary change that invalidates the model instead of merely repeating a formula.

quiz.question: 審查「明密文邊界」的原理與架構時，哪個說法成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which principle/architecture claim is justified for plain/cipher boundaries?
options: 同態加密使所有輸出永不可讀。
只要一次輸出符合預期，就能推定「明密文邊界」對所有資料量、版本與故障條件都成立。
同態運算保護處理中資料但允許解密結果可見。
optionsEn: Homomorphic encryption makes all outputs unreadable forever.
One matching output proves plain/cipher boundaries for all sizes, versions and failure conditions.
Homomorphic computation protects processing while allowing result decryption.
quiz.explanation: 同態運算保護處理中資料但允許解密結果可見。 畫資料持有者、運算者及結果接收者。 因此「同態加密使所有輸出永不可讀。」混淆了本單元必須分開檢查的條件。
quiz.explanationEn: Homomorphic computation protects processing while allowing result decryption. Draw data owner, evaluator and result recipient. The alternative "Homomorphic encryption makes all outputs unreadable forever." conflates conditions that must be checked separately.

steps.title: 明密文邊界：實驗與證據
steps.objective: 以「明密文邊界」建立可重算實驗、錯誤辨識與驗收證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Build reproducible experiments, diagnosis and acceptance evidence for plain/cipher boundaries.
steps.instruction: 重播本單元示意後，僅在自製資料、副本或本地合成環境驗證，不連線真實目標、不取得旁人資料。實作：「畫資料持有者、運算者及結果接收者。」；將結果與「同態運算保護處理中資料但允許解密結果可見。」逐項對照。保留基準和變更後輸出，先列至少兩個可能造成差異的原因，再用版本、單位、誤差或信任邊界排除其中一項。未有實測的數值須明寫為假想值。最後寫出透過／保留的理由和仍待驗證條件。
steps.instructionEn: Replay the unit, then validate only self-made data, copies or a local synthetic environment; do not connect to real targets or collect other people's data. Exercise: Draw data owner, evaluator and result recipient. Compare results against: Homomorphic computation protects processing while allowing result decryption. Preserve baseline and changed outputs. List at least two competing causes and discriminate one using versions, units, errors or trust boundaries. Label unmeasured values hypothetical. Document pass/hold reasons and remaining conditions.
steps.observation: 畫資料持有者、運算者及結果接收者。 核對上述原理的適用範圍並記錄不符合預期之處。
steps.observationEn: Draw data owner, evaluator and result recipient. Check the scope of the stated principle and record departures from expectations.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：同態加密使所有輸出永不可讀。 應檢查資料版本、單位、信任邊界與可區分原因的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Homomorphic encryption makes all outputs unreadable forever. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 提交「明密文邊界」實驗輸出、基準差異、誤判排除與限用條件；解釋「同態加密使所有輸出永不可讀。」為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: Submit outputs, baseline differences, rejected misconceptions and limits for plain/cipher boundaries; explain why this claim fails: Homomorphic encryption makes all outputs unreadable forever.

steps.titleEn: BFV and CKKS: principles and architecture
steps.objective: 以「BFV 與 CKKS」建立原理、介面與可反駁模型。
steps.objectiveEn: Build principles, interfaces and a falsifiable model for bfv and ckks.
steps.instruction: 先觀察師傅的「BFV 與 CKKS」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：BFV 做模整數運算，CKKS 表達近似數值。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「比較整數計數與浮點統計的方案需求。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。

Principle: BFV computes modular integers; CKKS represents approximate values. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Compare scheme needs for integer counts and floating statistics. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

只要一次輸出符合預期，就能推定「BFV 與 CKKS」對所有資料量、版本與故障條件都成立。
optionsEn: BFV computes modular integers; CKKS represents approximate values.
CKKS guarantees exact arbitrary real numbers.
One matching output proves bfv and ckks for all sizes, versions and failure conditions.
quiz.explanation: BFV 做模整數運算，CKKS 表達近似數值。 比較整數計數與浮點統計的方案需求。 因此「CKKS 保證任意實數完全精確。」混淆了本單元必須分開檢查的條件。
quiz.explanationEn: BFV computes modular integers; CKKS represents approximate values. Compare scheme needs for integer counts and floating statistics. The alternative "CKKS guarantees exact arbitrary real numbers." conflates conditions that must be checked separately.

steps.title: BFV 與 CKKS：實驗與證據
steps.titleEn: BFV and CKKS: experiments and evidence
steps.objective: 以「BFV 與 CKKS」建立可重算實驗、錯誤辨識與驗收證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Build reproducible experiments, diagnosis and acceptance evidence for bfv and ckks.
steps.instruction: 重播本單元示意後，僅在自製資料、副本或本地合成環境驗證，不連線真實目標、不取得旁人資料。實作：「比較整數計數與浮點統計的方案需求。」；將結果與「BFV 做模整數運算，CKKS 表達近似數值。」逐項對照。保留基準和變更後輸出，先列至少兩個可能造成差異的原因，再用版本、單位、誤差或信任邊界排除其中一項。未有實測的數值須明寫為假想值。最後寫出透過／保留的理由和仍待驗證條件。
steps.instructionEn: Replay the unit, then validate only self-made data, copies or a local synthetic environment; do not connect to real targets or collect other people's data. Exercise: Compare scheme needs for integer counts and floating statistics. Compare results against: BFV computes modular integers; CKKS represents approximate values. Preserve baseline and changed outputs. List at least two competing causes and discriminate one using versions, units, errors or trust boundaries. Label unmeasured values hypothetical. Document pass/hold reasons and remaining conditions.
steps.observation: 比較整數計數與浮點統計的方案需求。 核對上述原理的適用範圍並記錄不符合預期之處。
steps.observationEn: Compare scheme needs for integer counts and floating statistics. Check the scope of the stated principle and record departures from expectations.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：CKKS 保證任意實數完全精確。 應檢查資料版本、單位、信任邊界與可區分原因的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: CKKS guarantees exact arbitrary real numbers. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 提交「BFV 與 CKKS」實驗輸出、基準差異、誤判排除與限用條件；解釋「CKKS 保證任意實數完全精確。」為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: Submit outputs, baseline differences, rejected misconceptions and limits for bfv and ckks; explain why this claim fails: CKKS guarantees exact arbitrary real numbers.

steps.title: 安全參數：原理與架構
steps.objective: 以「安全參數」建立原理、介面與可反駁模型。
steps.objectiveEn: Build principles, interfaces and a falsifiable model for security parameters.
steps.instruction: 先觀察師傅的「安全參數」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：多項式維度與密文模數需共同滿足安全估計。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「讀正式參數列而不將玩具值當安全配置。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。
steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor demonstration for security parameters. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Polynomial dimension and ciphertext modulus jointly affect security estimates. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Read standard tables without treating toy values as secure. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.
steps.observation: 讀正式參數列而不將玩具值當安全配置。 核對上述原理的適用範圍並記錄不符合預期之處。
steps.observationEn: Read standard tables without treating toy values as secure. Check the scope of the stated principle and record departures from expectations.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：較大密文模數一定提高安全性。 應檢查資料版本、單位、信任邊界與可區分原因的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Larger ciphertext modulus always improves security. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 提交「安全參數」兩情境架構圖、假設與可反駁預測，並說明「讀正式參數列而不將玩具值當安全配置。」如何辨別它們。
steps.checkEn: Submit a two-case architecture, assumptions and falsifiable prediction for security parameters; explain how the proposed evidence discriminates the cases.

optionsEn: Larger ciphertext modulus always improves security.
